expected_regions.name: logo
expected_regions.description: Institution logo/wordmark in the top-left header band - common to most local bank letterheads regardless of institution.

notes: Deliberately institution-agnostic (empty institution_name list means any institution name is accepted) - covers the common letterhead layout shared by several local banks rather than one specific statement format. Add an institution-specific template ahead of this one in the directory listing order if you need it to take priority; matching stops at the first template whose expected fields are satisfied.
